hs_price_needs_quantity.name: hs_price_needs_quantity
hs_price_needs_quantity.value: "price" IS NULL OR "quantity" IS NOT NULL

itx_buy.name: itx_buy
itx_buy.value: "type" <> 'buy' OR ("security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quantity" > 0 AND "amount_cents" <= 0)

itx_sell.name: itx_sell
itx_sell.value: "type" <> 'sell' OR ("security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quantity" > 0 AND "amount_cents" >= 0)

itx_reinvest.name: itx_reinvest
itx_reinvest.value: "type" <> 'reinvest' OR ("security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quantity" > 0 AND "amount_cents" <= 0)

itx_split.name: itx_split
itx_split.value: (("type" = 'split') = ("split_num" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("type" = 'split') = ("split_den" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("type" <> 'split' OR ("security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "split_num" > 0 AND "split_den" > 0 AND "amount_cents" = 0))

itx_transfer.name: itx_transfer
itx_transfer.value: (("type" = 'transfer') = ("transfer_direction" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("type" <> 'transfer' OR (("security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "amount_cents" = 0 AND "quantity" > 0) OR ("security_id" IS NULL AND "amount_cents" <> 0 AND (("transfer_direction" = 'in') = ("amount_cents" > 0)))))

itx_basis_only_in.name: itx_basis_only_in
itx_basis_only_in.value: ("cost_basis_cents" IS NULL AND "acquired_date" IS NULL) OR ("type" = 'transfer' AND "transfer_direction" = 'in' AND "security_id" IS NOT NULL)
